en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 1.  Imam  Ja’far  Sadiq  (a.s.)  says,  “One  who  recites  Qul huwallaahu  ah’ad,  innaa  anzalnaahu  fee  lailatil  qadr  and ayatal kursi in a recommended prayer Allah would consider his deed best except for that person who has performed it more than him.”
